description: Defines a Flutter widget 'TopHeadlineCard' that displays a news article preview with an image and headline. Includes a private '_HeroImage' widget for image rendering with placeholders and error handling.

classes.name: TopHeadlineCard
classes.description: A stateless widget representing a card with a news article's image and headline, handling tap gestures.

classes.name: _HeroImage
classes.description: A private stateless widget that displays an image from a URL with placeholder and error widgets.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the widget tree for both 'TopHeadlineCard' and '_HeroImage', defining their UI layout.
